local me = Game.GetLocalPlayer() local pCity = CityManager.GetCity(me, 16777216 % 65536) if pCity == nil then print("ERR:CITY_NOT_FOUND"); print("---END---"); return end
local cost = pCity:GetGold():GetPlotPurchaseCost(43, 10)
if cost <= 0 then print("ERR:NOT_PURCHASABLE|Tile (43,10) is not purchasable by this city"); print("---END---"); return end
local balance = Players[me]:GetTreasury():GetGoldBalance()
if balance < cost then
    print("ERR:INSUFFICIENT_GOLD|Need " .. cost .. " gold, have " .. math.floor(balance)); print("---END---"); return
end
local tParams = {}
tParams[CityCommandTypes.PARAM_PLOT_PURCHASE] = 1
tParams[CityCommandTypes.PARAM_X] = 43
tParams[CityCommandTypes.PARAM_Y] = 10
CityManager.RequestCommand(pCity, CityCommandTypes.PURCHASE, tParams)
print("OK:TILE_PURCHASED|(43,10)|cost:" .. cost)
print("---END---")
